'''Choren 21 (September 21)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|999}} - [[Moiraine]] and [[Lanfear]] disappear through the [[redstone doorframe]] ''[[ter'angreal]]'', presumed dead. [[Egwene]] and [[Aviendha]] injured. [[Rand]] uses balefire on [[Rahvin]] in [[Caemlyn]]. [[Nynaeve]] captures [[Moghedien]] in ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]''. [[Asmodean]] dies. [[Davram Bashere]] arrives in Caemlyn chasing [[Mazrim Taim]]. Rand announces an amnesty for all men who can channel.
*{{ne|999}} - The [[Wise Ones]] meet with [[Sheriam]]'s group.
